app.name: CareNest
app.tagline: Coordinate care for the people you love — together, from anywhere.

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.errorNetwork: We couldn't reach CareNest. Check your internet connection and try again.
common.notAllowed: You don't have permission to see this.

landing.intro: One shared place for medicines, appointments, caregiver visits and family tasks — so everyone knows what has been done and what still needs someone.
landing.featureMedsBody: Reminders and confirmations. An unanswered reminder is shown as unconfirmed — never assumed taken or missed.
landing.featureFamilyBody: Every task, appointment and ride has a named person, or is clearly marked as still needing one.
landing.featureDignityBody: A simple, large-text view for parents, with privacy choices that stay in their hands.

safety.notEmergencyService: CareNest is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
auth.name: Your name
auth.timeZoneHint: Times are shown in this zone. You can change it later.

home.intro: Care circles, medicines and schedules will appear here as they are set up.
home.noCircles: You're not part of a care circle yet.
home.noCirclesHint: A care circle is the group of people who look after one person — family, caregivers and anyone else they trust. Create one, or ask a family member to invite you.

account.title: Your account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.devicesIntro: If you don't recognise a device, or a shared tablet should no longer be signed in, sign it out here.
account.noOtherDevices: No other devices are signed in.

roleHints.care_recipient: The person this circle is for. They see their own information and, if they manage their own care, decide what is shared.
roleHints.admin: Manages the circle: invites people, edits the profile and coordinates.
roleHints.family: Sees shared updates, takes on tasks and appointments.
roleHints.caregiver: Sees assigned care tasks, medicines and visits.
roleHints.clinician: Sees medicines, appointments and health notes. CareNest does not verify professional credentials.
roleHints.emergency_contact: Only receives emergency alerts and sees the emergency information card.

circle.newIntro: Tell us about the person you're caring for. You can change all of this later.
circle.creatorAdmin: I'm a family member or friend organising care
circle.creatorSelf: I'm the person who will receive care
circle.preferredName: What do they like to be called?
circle.preferredNameHint: Shown in reminders and on their screen.
circle.timeZoneHint: Medicine times and visits follow this time zone, wherever the family lives.
circle.countryHint: Used to show the right emergency number.
circle.selfManaging: Can they make their own care and privacy decisions?
circle.selfManagingYes: Yes — they decide what is shared with family
circle.selfManagingNo: No — they need someone to decide for them
circle.selfManagingHint: Choose “Yes” unless they truly can't. They can always see their own information.
circle.noAccount: Doesn't have a CareNest account yet
circle.comingSoon: Medicines, appointments, tasks and visits will appear here as each part of CareNest is switched on.
circle.inviteTemporaryHint: For temporary help, such as a relief caregiver. Leave empty for ongoing access.
circle.inviteCreated: Invitation created. CareNest can't send emails yet, so share this link with them yourself. It works once and expires in 7 days:
circle.leaveConfirm: You will lose access to this circle immediately. Continue?
circle.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this circle? They lose access immediately.
circle.privacyIntro: Caregivers and healthcare professionals in the circle always see what they need to give care. These choices control what family members and admins can see.
circle.privacyAdmin: Family admins decide these settings because {name} does not manage their own care decisions.
circle.shareHealth: Health details (date of birth, health notes)
circle.autonomyOn: {name} currently manages their own care decisions.
circle.autonomyOff: {name}'s care decisions are currently made with family.
circle.autonomyConfirm: This changes who controls privacy and membership. It is recorded in the activity log. Continue?
circle.archiveIntro: Archiving makes the circle read-only. Nothing is deleted and everyone keeps read access.
circle.archiveConfirm: Archive this circle? It becomes read-only for everyone.
circle.isArchived: This circle is archived and read-only.
circle.activityIntro: A record of important changes, so {name} and the admins can see who did what.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to join “{circle}”, the care circle for {recipient}, as: {role}.
invite.status_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask {inviter} to send a new one.
invite.status_accepted: This invitation has already been used.
invite.invalid: This invitation link isn't valid. Check you copied the whole link.

audit.consent_updated: changed what is shared with family
audit.member_updated: changed a member's role or access

meds.noDoses: No scheduled doses on this day.
meds.unconfirmedHelp: Nobody has confirmed this dose yet. Check with {name} or their caregiver. Don't give an extra dose to make up for it unless a doctor or pharmacist says so.
meds.shifted: Clocks changed today, so this dose moved from {time}.
meds.noMedicines: No medicines have been added yet.
meds.lowSupply: Running low — time to arrange a refill.
meds.stopConfirm: Stop this medicine? It stays in the history, and upcoming doses are removed.
meds.formIntro: Enter the medicine exactly as the doctor or pharmacist prescribed it. CareNest never suggests or changes doses.
meds.name: Medicine name
meds.dosageHint: As written on the prescription, e.g. “1 tablet (500 mg)”.
meds.times: Times to take it (their local time)
meds.refillThreshold: Warn when this many are left (optional)
meds.notShared: {name} has chosen not to share medicines with family.

notif.reminderSelfBody: {dosage}. When you've taken it, tap “I took it”.
notif.reminderEmailBody: A medicine is due now. Open CareNest to see it and confirm it: {link}
notif.unconfirmedBody: {medicine} ({dosage}) was due at {time} their time. Nobody has confirmed it yet — that doesn't mean it was missed. Check in with {name}, then record what happened. Tap “I'm checking on it” so others know.
notif.unconfirmedEmailSubject: A medicine for {name} hasn't been confirmed
notif.unconfirmedEmailBody: A medicine that was due for {name} hasn't been confirmed yet. Open CareNest to see details and let others know you're checking: {link}
notif.escalatedBody: {medicine} was due at {time} their time and is still unconfirmed, and nobody has said they are checking. Please check on {name}.
notif.escalatedEmailBody: A medicine for {name} is still unconfirmed and nobody has said they are checking. Open CareNest: {link}
notif.refillBody: {count} left for {name}. Time to arrange a refill.
notif.refillEmailSubject: A medicine for {name} is running low
notif.refillEmailBody: One of {name}'s medicines is running low. Open CareNest to see which: {link}
